tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Previous purchase order copies of Consumables & Chemicals supplied to Govt. Hospitals or Institutions or Autonomous institutions or Private hospitals in the year 2023-24 and 2024-25 & 2025-26 should be uploaded. Uploaded documents must be attested by notary. Quoted items or similar items supplied Purchase order copies should be uploaded.

User certificate copies of Consumables & Chemicals supplied to Govt. Hospitals or Institutions or Autonomous institutions or Private hospitals in the year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 should be uploaded. Uploaded documents must be attested by notary.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: GST registration certificate GST R-3B certificates from April 2026 to SEP 2026 should be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Annual turnover statement issued by CA for the financial year 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 should be uploaded. The annual turnover of the firm for every year is not less than Rs. 100 lakhs as otherwise the tender is liable to be rejected.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: GST registration certificate GST R-3B certificates from April 2026 to SEP 2026 should be uploaded.

Manufacturer Authorization Form from Principal Manufacturer for the relevant items as per section VII, Annexure I with Drug license copy of manufacturer. In the authorization form name of the products should be mentioned.
Valid Drug License of the Bidder should be uploaded.
Valid GMP or WHO or FDA or any relevant Certificates of the manufacturer should be uploaded.
